title: LlamaIndex deferred streaming response loses MLflow parent context and splits or leaves the trace open
answers: LlamaIndex streaming query trace shows up as a separate trace or never finishes
streamed LlamaIndex response creates a new trace with newer llama-index-core
MLflow tracing LlamaIndex streaming chat is incomplete after llama-index-core upgrade
body:
Symptom: With llama-index-core 0.14.25+, streamed query/chat responses produce a second trace, or the original streaming trace stays unfinished.
Root cause: mlflow/llama_index/tracer.py:StreamResolver.register_stream_span. LlamaIndex clears its span context before its deferred generator resumes, so spans created while chunks are pulled have no parent. MlflowSpanHandler.new_span only looked up open_spans, not _pending_spans, so pending parents were ignored.
Fix pattern: wrap the deferred generator with StreamResolver._with_span_context so every next()/__anext__() runs inside _stream_span_context, which restores the MLflow span and the LlamaIndex active_span_id for that step only. Make MlflowSpanHandler.new_span resolve the parent from _pending_spans as well as open_spans.
Constraints: applies only to StreamingResponse/AsyncStreamingResponse results. If the generator belongs to an already-pending child, the innermost pending span is used as the context. Without llama_index.core.instrumentation.span.active_span_id (older releases) the LlamaIndex context is skipped.
applies: Any change to LlamaIndex streaming result handling or span parenting in mlflow/llama_index/tracer.py.
says: Streaming chat responses split into multiple separate traces in the trace UI.
The trace timeline for streaming queries stays open indefinitely and never finishes.
Streaming query traces appear fragmented into two separate entries in the experiment view.
Streaming chat interactions do not nest properly under the parent trace in tracking.
search: In mlflow/llama_index/tracer.py, StreamResolver._with_span_context wraps deferred streaming generators so _stream_span_context restores span context during iteration. MlflowSpanHandler.new_span resolves parent spans from both open_spans and _pending_spans for StreamingResponse and AsyncStreamingResponse results, using the innermost pending span when applicable. Restoring the LlamaIndex active_span_id is skipped if llama_index.core.instrumentation.span.active_span_id is unavailable on older versions.
